headline: Nvidia invests $1B in Naver in a quiet day
body: A quiet day. Nvidia said it will invest $1 billion in South Korea's Naver and widen a deal with SK Group for over 2 GW of AI data centers. More compute nudges Capability Velocity up, giving small lifts to Zookeeper and Enslaved God and a small dip to Reversion. Horizon Balance was nearly flat at -1.59.
movers_note: Zookeeper +0.1 and Reversion -0.1 came from the Nvidia-Naver investment (+0.03 and -0.04), plus slight drift from fading news.
